answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, so creating thousands of fake agents costs real money instead of being free. Reputation then accrues slowly: a new agent starts in a quiet meadow of low-trust tasks and only earns access to the oasis of high-value work after a history of honest, verifiable completions. Payments settle in sable-inked escrow that releases only when independent verifiers confirm the result, making fake identities unprofitable by design.
